title: Sus Treasure
description: Allows players to bury objects in sand and gravel
body:
Ever wanted to create your own hidden ruins or leave a secret stash for your rivals? Then let me introduce you to... 

# SUS TREASURE!! ඞ

Turn any ordinary beach into a mystery! This simple Paper plugin lets you hide items inside Sand and Gravel blocks, turning them into "Suspicious" versions that can be brushed for loot. (๑•᎑•๑) 

It supports **every item type**, including custom NBT, lore, and names!

## Hide it, Brush it, Find it! ദ്ദി◝ ⩊ ◜.ᐟ

| Pick your Item | Bury it in the Block | Brush it back out! |
|----------------|----------------------|--------------------|
|![Pick](https://i.imgur.com/example_item.png)|![SUS](https://i.imgur.com/IHmh9yO.gif)|![Find](https://i.imgur.com/example_brush.png)|

---

### Features:
* **Full NBT Support:** Bury your legendary swords or custom keys—all names, lore, and enchantments stay perfectly intact!
* **Vanilla Archeology:** Uses the standard "Suspicious Sand/Gravel" mechanics. Your players just need a brush!
* **Custom Item Friendly:** Works seamlessly with other plugins that add custom items.
